data: For which number of adaptation utterances are there CER (%) measurements?

The caption states that the figure shows CER (%) for different method combinations. The x-axis represents the number of adaptation utterances, ranging from 0 to 300. The y-axis represents CER (%). The lines in the graph represent different method combinations. The question asks for the number of adaptation utterances for which there are CER (%) measurements. From the analysis, it is clear that there are CER (%) measurements for all the number of adaptation utterances shown on the x-axis, from 0 to 300. Therefore, the answer is all the number of adaptation utterances from 0 to 300.
